thesis: Mohnish Pabrai argues that investors can develop an unfair advantage by studying mental models derived from direct experience and reading Charlie Munger's essay on the 25 causes of human misjudgment. He illustrates how humans have a hard-coded but flawed tendency to reciprocate favors, noting that because people cannot calibrate the size of a favor, a small gift like a $30 pen can create a disproportionate obligation that leads to favorable opinions or business deals, while also highlighting that humans have an irrational aversion to cloning successful ideas even when the market allows for multiple participants.
